title.narrative: The 2024 programme support was largely dedicated to the roll-out of the new Country Programme and life-saving response to the affected children and women, suffering from the tragic landslide in Mulitaka. This entailed adjusting the priorities and mobilizing the needed resources, including joint activities with the Government and other stakeholders.
